chunks.text:
Source-anchor feasibility uses deterministic text blocks. This ordinary paragraph is long enough to exercise parser normalization and stable block identity without relying on private user data.
A second paragraph provides a separate source block with an explicit page-local rectangle. It includes repeated anchor words and a short conclusion so the mapping probe can test stable ordinal ordering.
The final block records that source coordinates are measured in PDF points and normalized by the page width and height. Every expected coordinate comes from PyMuPDF display extraction rather than an assumed layout.
